description: This file defines the code-behind for a web page that displays and processes answers for an online examination system. It retrieves answers from a database for specific questions, displays them in text controls, and allows submitting marks and updating database records accordingly.

classes.name: OnlineExamSystem.ShowAns
classes.description: Partial class for the ShowAns ASP.NET Web Form page, handling display of answers and submission of marks.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event. Retrieves student answers from the database for multiple questions and populates corresponding text controls. Redirects if session variables are missing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event to navigate the user to the admin panel.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event to navigate to the admin queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event to navigate to the admin leaderboard.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Handles submission of marks for answers, updates the database with total marks, removes the student from the course queue, and possibly updates admin queue count.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the login page.

calls: sql update and delete commands execution
